title: On Ball's conjectured Santaló type inequality
summary: We prove that if $K$ is a symmetric and isotropic convex body in $\mathbb{R}^n$, then $$\int_K\langle x,u\rangle^2\,dx\int_{K^\circ}\langle x,u\rangle^2\,dx\leq \left(\int_{B_2^n}\langle x,u\rangle^2\,dx\right)^2,\qquad\forall u\in\mathbb{R}^n,$$with equality for some $u\neq o$, if and only if $K$ is a Euclidean ball.
